name: Arctic Instruments
description: Arctic Instruments is a VTT spin-off specializing in superconducting amplifiers for quantum computers. The company develops ultra-low-noise quantum-limited amplifiers essential for reading out quantum states in superconducting quantum processors. Arctic Instruments' technology enables more accurate and faster qubit measurements, improving the performance and scalability of quantum computing systems.

products.name: Quantum-Limited Amplifiers
products.description: Ultra-low-noise superconducting amplifiers for high-fidelity qubit state readout in quantum processors

highlights: Spin-off from VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland
Secured EUR 2.35M seed round in 2024 to commercialize quantum amplifier technology
Enables faster and more accurate qubit measurements for superconducting quantum computers
